prompt:
Vertical 9:16 candid lifestyle photograph, shot on a 35mm lens with shallow depth of field, natural window light, warm but true-to-life color, fine film grain. No text, no logos, no brand labels, no readable writing anywhere. No face visible: the frame shows only hands and forearms.

Scene: late afternoon at a wooden desk beside a window. A man's hands in heather-grey cardigan cuffs hold a pair of reading glasses and are about to turn the page of an open hardcover book with simple, elegant scientific illustrations of cells and plants (no readable words). Beside the book: a notebook with a pencil and faint, illegible handwritten notes, and a cup of tea. Warm sunlight falls across the pages; tiny specks of dust float in the beam. Composition: the open book and hands fill the center, light from the upper right.
